title: Transcription tooling
blocker: Feed and Messaging each run 5+ client sessions per month; manual note-taking from recordings is unsustainable
impact: 30–40% of researcher time spent on notes, increased synthesis lag, accuracy risk in documentation
unlock: +3–5 studies/month, faster decision cycles, reduced researcher burnout, improved synthesis quality

title: Client access for recruiting
blocker: Researchers lack direct access to clients for study participation
impact: Multi-week recruiting delays, reliance on account managers, limited panel diversity, missed validation windows
unlock: Same-week recruiting for validation studies, faster feedback loops, increased study volume

title: Qual platform tooling
blocker: Recorder/plugin constraints, screener access, security/compliance needs under active evaluation
impact: Manual workflows, inconsistent data capture, limited remote testing capability, compliance friction
unlock: Standardized research ops, better artifact management, improved collaboration, compliant remote studies
